title: Zesty Orange Kenyan Vegetable Wrap
description: A flavorful and refreshing Kenyan-inspired vegetable wrap featuring orange zest and a tangy mustard sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Dijon mustard and mayonnaise until smooth.
Add the orange zest to the mustard sauce and stir to combine.
Place a large tortilla in the skillet and warm for 30 seconds on each side.
Spread a quarter of the mustard sauce down the center of the tortilla, leaving a small border around the edges.
Top the sauce with a quarter of the mixed greens, sliced cucumber, and sliced carrots.
Sprinkle a quarter of the chopped cilantro over the top of the vegetables.
Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients to make three more wraps.
